name: ver02-c3c-flytrap-multi-engulf
description: S6 checkpoint C3c / VER-02 G3: two simultaneously engulfed victims owned by one Giant Flytrap, on the accepted C3a product (unchanged). The product runs alone with the read-only hold lifecycle observer. Launch 1 (multi): a Purple Worm swallow is the independent ownership control (with an unrelated Bull's Strength effect); one Flytrap holds two Medium victims A and B through real bites on two distinct limbs and both are engulfed by its own later-round maintain. A dies through the native death path (exact removal, A's limb freed, B unchanged and continuing on its schedule); A's freed limb takes C through a real bite and C is promoted by the real maintain; B and C age through a payload round and go through a finished native save with paused-state preservation, then the next payload round; then the living Flytrap dies with both engulfed (release, bounded quiet interval, control intact). Launch 2 (reload): a fresh process loads the save written before the Flytrap's death and checks the intentional reset for the named holder and both saved victims. Disclosed setup: holder BAB 100, victim HP raised, appear buffs removed, brains off, units woken, navmesh placement, pauses for observation; a fresh setup only after an ordinary failed maintain (exact result 'released', exact holder and target, attempt window), at most two per probe, every attempt kept.
